The '''LPL 2021 Summer''' was the summer split of the [[LoL Pro League]] ('''LPL''') organized by TJ Sports, held from June 7 to September 2, 2021, across multiple cities in China including Shanghai, Hangzhou, Suzhou, Shenzhen, Xi'an, and Beijing. The Group Stage took place at team home venues, while the playoffs were conducted in a King-of-the-Hill and Double-Elimination format. Seventeen teams competed in a single round-robin Group Stage, with the top ten advancing to playoffs. All matches in the Group Stage were {{Abbr/Bo3}}, while playoff matches were {{Abbr/Bo5}}. The total prize pool was ¥4,200,000 CNY, with the winner qualifying for the [[World Championship/2021|Worlds 2021]]. The split was played on patches 11.11–11.15, with [[Akshan]] disabled from the playoffs.

===Playoffs===
{{ShowBracket|id=TA11tbTVax}}

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''June 7th - August 8th, 2021''
** Single round robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** Top 10 advanced to [[LPL/2021/Spring/Playoffs|Playoffs]]
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to Round 2 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''7th till 10th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''11th till 17th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
<!--** Tiebreakers
*** If two or more teams have won the same number of matches, the tie will be broken by the order:
***# Games differential
***# Head-to-head results-->

*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 12th - September 2nd, 2021''
** '''''Phase One: King-of-the-Hill'''''
*** 3rd - 10th seeded teams from Group Stage are divided into two brackets to play a King-of-the-Hill format
**** 3rd, 6th, 7th and 10th seed are in one bracket (the first bracket), the other 4 seeds are in the other
**** The winners advance to Phase Two
**** The winner of the first bracket faces 2nd seed team in the Double-Elimination Stage, the other faces the 1st seed
** '''''Phase Two: Double-Elimination'''''
*** Four teams play in a Double-Elimination format to compete for the championship
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2021|World Championship 2021]]

*'''Free Side Selection Privilege'''
** The teams have Free Side Selection Privilege can choose which '''''three''''' games of the {{Abbr/Bo5}} series to pick the side
** At the last match of Playoffs ''Phase One'' and the lower bracket matches of Playoffs ''Phase Two'', the Free Side Selection Privilege will be determined by coin toss. Besides that, the higher seeded teams (in Grand Finals, the upper bracket winner) will have the Free Side Selection Privilege.
